full_page.content:
Page 99 Cont.
Sep. 22 Peter Ellor - 71 - baptized Cach. but hardly anything further. His wife died lately and the children are anxious to have their Father pray and be religious.
Lawrence Scoball - 37 - in Ypsilanti State hosp. - mental. Has wife and little boy of 8 yrs.
Page 100
Sep. Glenn Jones - 46 - serious nerve break-down in Eloise - Baptist - Wife Catholic.
Elias Van Hee - 52 - fearfully sore throat and Headaches - Jen- nings -
Thomas Sommers - 60 - intestinal flue- - 104 fever Reardon Fam. - He in Chicago etc
29th Rev. Gerard Donnelly S. J. - very serious eye condition - called "detached retina". It seems already miraculous that he can still see. They hope for further help so as to complete the miracle. Helen Heffernan - 30 - of Toronto, in Ont.
Mrs. Antonina Zychski - 60 - diabitis gangrene - heart too weak to operate - from Richmond - now Grace Hosp.
Jas. Pawlowicz - 18 - Epyleptic
Page 101 Sep. 29 Elias Vanhee - 52 - in Jennings Hospital serious throat and head trouble; promises more frequent Communion than once a year if re- stored to health.
Blanch Migno - 65 - hopeless cancer - husband 79 ... .wants to live if it be God's will to help husband.
Mary Ann MMesaw - 87 - of Tweed, Ontario Ca. (400 mi.) wants - needs a woman to help. Her folks here in Detroit ask for prayers .....
29 Beulah Balduck - 46 - of baptist parents, "down and out every way" never baptized .....
